mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases month-over-month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, it signals a tight labor market and strong economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL above 5.0% and fall in INDPRO below 100.0 indicates stagflation, which triggers central bank tightening and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 5.0 and INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a housing starts (HOUST) above 1200.0 thousand units signals resilient demand for housing, which supports economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 1200.0 and FEDFUNDS > 1.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is low (below 0.5%), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises above 5.0%, it signals accelerating inflation, prompting central bank tightening and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 5.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) above 1200.0 thousand units signals strong demand for housing, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 1200.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
